routeAdjustment: Use the existing original primitive character and constructed common local field; native algebraic-closure embedding existence and finite-domain field structure give the residual maximal ideal. No new residue-field finiteness or local completion development.

Reduction in its actual finite residue field gives a Hecke eigencharacter with maximal kernel and exactly the reduced original Fourier coefficients at all positive indices. No coefficient field, local extension, embedding or residual eigencharacter existence premise is supplied to the final existence theorem.
